A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toong'l/Legends|Toong'l]] occurred durign the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. After the [[Battle of Caluula]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] attacked Toong'l.<ref name="TEA" /> The Vong then established a [[yammosk]] outpost on the planet, in preparation for the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Defense of Mon Calamari]].<ref name="TUF" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle makes its unique appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The battle is only illustrated on the galactic map of the conflict.
